MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { FHE, euint64, externalEuint64, sharedEuint64, ebool } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\nimport { EnumerableSet } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/structs/EnumerableSet.sol\";\nimport { SafeCast } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeCast.sol\";\nimport { FHESafeMath } from \"../utils/FHESafeMath.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20Utils } from \"../FHERC20/utils/FHERC20Utils.sol\";\nimport { ERC20ConfidentialIndicator } from \"./ERC20ConfidentialIndicator.sol\";\n\n/// @dev Self-only bridge the host token exposes so this delegatecall'd library can\n/// reach the host's ledger hooks (`_ledgerTransfer` / `_ledgerMint`) for the\n/// shield / unshield-claim / mint orchestration relocated here.\ninterface IConfidentialLedger {\n    /// @dev `from == address(0)` \u21d2 ledger mint; otherwise ledger transfer.\n    function __ledger(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external;\n\n    /// @dev The host's standard public ERC-20 `balanceOf` (every host IS an ERC-20; no\n    /// self-only bridge needed for a public view). Used to derive the confidential total\n    /// supply from the pool's balance.\n    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);\n}\n\n/// @dev Mint-mode resolved per account by an {IMintModePolicy}: whether freshly minted\n/// public tokens should stay public or be auto-shielded into the confidential layer.\n/// Tri-state so a policy's per-user mapping can distinguish \"never set\" (UNSET \u2192 fall\n/// back to a default) from an explicit choice. UNSET is never a valid resolved mode.\nenum MintMode {\n    UNSET,\n    PUBLIC,\n    PRIVATE\n}\n\n/// @dev Policy consulted by {ERC20ConfidentialLib.autoShield} on every mint-and-shield\n/// candidate (e.g. a wrap that mints public tokens). Hosts supply their own policy\n/// implementation; this library only consumes the resolved mode.\ninterface IMintModePolicy {\n    function mintModeFor(address account) external view returns (MintMode);\n}\n\n/**\n * @title  ERC20ConfidentialLib\n * @notice External (linked, delegatecall'd) home for the heaviest confidential balance logic, so\n *         that code lives in this library's own deployed bytecode instead of being embedded in\n *         every host token. Used by {ERC20ConfidentialCoreUpgradeable} to keep a token that fuses\n *         the confidential layer with a large public base under the EIP-170\n *         24 KB limit WITHOUT dropping any functionality.\n *\n * @dev    `public` library functions \u2192 the compiler emits `delegatecall`, so they run in the\n *         HOST's context: `address(this)` is the token and `msg.sender` is the original caller \u2014\n *         exactly what the FHE ACL grants (`allowThis` / `allow(_, msg.sender)`) and the operator\n *         checks need. The storage struct is passed by reference (resolves to the host's ERC-7201\n *         slot) and is defined HERE so host and library share one type. Functions that need the\n *         host's public ledger (`shield`/`unshield`/mint) stay in the host; everything purely\n *         confidential lives here.\n */\nlibrary ERC20ConfidentialLib {\n    /// @custom:storage-location erc7201:fherc20.storage.ERC20Confidential\n    struct ERC20ConfidentialStorage {\n        mapping(address => euint64) _confidentialBalances;\n        mapping(address => mapping(address => uint48)) _operators;\n        ERC20ConfidentialIndicator _indicatorToken;\n        uint8 _decimals;\n        uint8 _confidentialDecimals;\n        uint256 _conversionRate;\n        // Compliance observer (ERC-7984-style). When set, every confidential\n        // balance handle produced by `update()` is also FHE.allow'd to it, so the\n        // observer can decrypt going forward. Past handles are topped up via\n        // `grantPast`. Append-only field \u2014 keep last for storage-layout safety.\n        address _observer;\n        // REGISTERED ciphertext mirroring the confidential total supply (pool balance / rate).\n        // Refreshed by `syncConfidentialTotalSupply` on every pool-balance change; publicly\n        // decryptable since the plaintext is derivable from public state. Zero handle until the\n        // first refresh. Append-only fields only below this point.\n        euint64 _confidentialTotalSupply;\n    }\n\n    // Pool that custodies the public ledger tokens backing confidential balances.\n    // Mirrors the constant in ERC20ConfidentialCoreUpgradeable.\n    address constant CONFIDENTIAL_POOL = address(0x1011000000000000000000000000000000000000);\n\n    // Mirrors ERC20ConfidentialCoreUpgradeable's ERC-7201 slot (the namespace is fixed,\n    // so it is identical for every host). Newer entry points ({autoShield},\n    // {setObserver}, {grantObserverPast}) resolve the slot HERE instead of taking a\n    // `storage $` parameter: their hosts sit at the EIP-170 ceiling, and dropping the\n    // parameter removes a 32-byte slot push from every host call site.\n    // keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256(\"fherc20.storage.ERC20Confidential\")) - 1)) & ~bytes32(uint256(0xff))\n    bytes32 private constant ERC20_CONFIDENTIAL_STORAGE_LOCATION =\n        0xb440e9c559aceef9e2c75ec16e8d26ee97396e4a6978215085407b7ab0709e00;\n\n    function _getERC20ConfidentialStorage() private pure returns (ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $) {\n        assembly {\n            $.slot := ERC20_CONFIDENTIAL_STORAGE_LOCATION\n        }\n    }\n\n    event ConfidentialTransfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, euint64 indexed amount);\n    // Signatures (and indexed-ness) must match IERC20ConfidentialCore so the\n    // host token's ABI/topics are unchanged when these are emitted via delegatecall.\n    event TokensShielded(address indexed account, uint256 amount);\n    event TokensUnshielded(address indexed account, euint64 indexed amount);\n    event UnshieldedTokensClaimed(\n        address indexed account,\n        bytes32 indexed unshieldRequestId,\n        euint64 indexed unshieldAmount,\n        uint64 unshieldAmountCleartext\n    );\n    // Emitted (as the host, via delegatecall) by the observer entry points relocated\n    // here from the hosts; signatures match the hosts' own declarations, so the\n    // topics/selector are identical either way.\n    event ObserverSet(address indexed observer);\n    event ObserverPastGranted(address indexed observer, uint256 count);\n\n    error ERC20ConfidentialUnauthorizedUseOfEncryptedAmount(euint64 value, address user);\n    error ERC20ConfidentialUnauthorizedSpender(address holder, address spender);\n    error ConfidentialInvalidSender(address sender);\n    error ConfidentialInvalidReceiver(address receiver);\n    error ConfidentialReceiverMovedBalance(address receiver);\n    error AmountTooSmallForConfidentialPrecision();\n    /// @notice Thrown when {grantObserverPast} runs with no observer configured.\n    error NoObserverSet();\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Core encrypted balance update (also used by the host for shield/mint)\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /// @dev Saturating decrease on `from`, increase on `to`, ACL grants, indicator mirror, and the\n    /// {ConfidentialTransfer} log. Returns the actually-moved (clamped) amount.\n    function update(address from, address to, euint64 amount) public returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        ebool success;\n        euint64 ptr;\n        address obs = $._observer; // compliance observer (0 = none); forward-grant below\n\n        if (from != address(0)) {\n            euint64 fromBalance = $._confidentialBalances[from];\n            (success, ptr) = FHESafeMath.tryDecrease(fromBalance, amount);\n            FHE.allowThis(ptr);\n            FHE.allow(ptr, from);\n            if (obs != address(0)) FHE.allow(ptr, obs);\n            $._confidentialBalances[from] = ptr;\n        }\n\n        transferred = from != address(0) ? FHE.select(success, amount, FHE.asEuint64(0)) : amount;\n\n        if (to != address(0)) {\n            ptr = FHE.add($._confidentialBalances[to], transferred);\n            FHE.allowThis(ptr);\n            FHE.allow(ptr, to);\n            if (obs != address(0)) FHE.allow(ptr, obs);\n            $._confidentialBalances[to] = ptr;\n        }\n\n        if (from != address(0)) FHE.allow(transferred, from);\n        if (to != address(0)) FHE.allow(transferred, to);\n        FHE.allowThis(transferred);\n        if (obs != address(0)) FHE.allow(transferred, obs);\n\n        ERC20ConfidentialIndicator ind = $._indicatorToken;\n        if (address(ind) != address(0)) ind.emitConfidentialTransfer(from, to);\n\n        emit ConfidentialTransfer(from, to, transferred);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Compliance observer \u2014 past-value top-up\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /// @dev Grant `observer` FHE access to historical ciphertext handles the host\n    /// already owns (`allowThis`'d) \u2014 past transfer amounts (from {ConfidentialTransfer}\n    /// events) and/or current balance handles (from `confidentialBalanceOf`). Closes\n    /// the forward-only gap of the observer hook in `update()`.\n    ///\n    /// Runs under delegatecall, so `FHE.allow` executes as the host token, which holds\n    /// permanent ACL on every handle it created. NOTE: on real CoFHE, a ctHash the host\n    /// never owned reverts the whole call \u2014 the off-chain indexer must supply only this\n    /// token's handles.\n    function grantPast(address observer, uint256[] calldata ctHashes) public {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ctHashes.length; i++) {\n            FHE.allow(euint64.wrap(bytes32(ctHashes[i])), observer);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Body of the hosts' `setObserver` (the host keeps only its access-control\n    ///      gate): a bare storage write plus the event.\n    function setObserver(address observer) public {\n        _getERC20ConfidentialStorage()._observer = observer;\n        emit ObserverSet(observer);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Body of the hosts' `grantObserverPast` (the host keeps only its\n    ///      access-control gate): grant the configured observer FHE access to\n    ///      historical handles the host owns.\n    function grantObserverPast(uint256[] calldata ctHashes) public {\n        address observer = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage()._observer;\n        if (observer == address(0)) revert NoObserverSet();\n        grantPast(observer, ctHashes);\n        emit ObserverPastGranted(observer, ctHashes.length);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Shield / unshield / mint orchestration (relocated from the host token to\n    //  fit under EIP-170; ledger ops reach the host via the self-only bridge).\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    function shield(uint256 amount) public {\n        shieldTo(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The shield primitive with an explicit recipient: moves `to`'s public tokens\n    ///      into the pool and credits `to`'s confidential balance. Strict like {shield}\n    ///      always was (dust-only amounts and uint64 overflow revert). `to`-addressed so\n    ///      flows where `msg.sender` is NOT the account being shielded (e.g. a wrap,\n    ///      where `msg.sender` is the SwapFacility) can use it via {autoShield}.\n    function shieldTo(address to, uint256 amount) public {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        uint256 rate = $._conversionRate;\n        uint256 amountToShield = amount - (amount % rate);\n        if (amountToShield == 0) revert AmountTooSmallForConfidentialPrecision();\n\n        uint64 amountConfidential = SafeCast.toUint64(amountToShield / rate);\n\n        IConfidentialLedger(address(this)).__ledger(to, CONFIDENTIAL_POOL, amountToShield);\n        update(address(0), to, FHE.asEuint64(amountConfidential));\n        syncConfidentialTotalSupply();\n\n        emit TokensShielded(to, amountToShield);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Shield `amount` (public base units, e.g. just minted by a wrap) into `to`'s\n    ///      confidential balance when the {IMintModePolicy} resolves PRIVATE for `to`.\n    ///\n    ///      Best-effort BY DESIGN \u2014 auto-shielding is sugar on top of the calling flow\n    ///      (typically a wrap, on the money path) and must never change its success\n    ///      envelope, so every non-shieldable case degrades to \"leave the mint public\"\n    ///      instead of reverting:\n    ///        - `mintModes == address(0)`: feature disabled at deployment;\n    ///        - policy call reverts: fail-open to PUBLIC;\n    ///        - sub-precision amount (`amount < rate`): nothing to shield \u2014 and as with\n    ///          {shield}, the `amount % rate` remainder always stays public;\n    ///        - amount exceeds the euint64 domain: the user can shield in parts.\n    ///\n    ///      The pre-checks guarantee the strict {shieldTo} cannot revert. No reentrancy\n    ///      surface beyond {shield}'s own: the ledger leg is a self-call into the host's\n    ///      `_transfer` and the FHE ops call the trusted task manager.\n    function autoShield(address mintModes, address to, uint256 amount) public {\n        if (mintModes == address(0)) return;\n        try IMintModePolicy(mintModes).mintModeFor(to) returns (MintMode mode) {\n            if (mode != MintMode.PRIVATE) return;\n        } catch {\n            return;\n        }\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        uint256 rate = $._conversionRate;\n        uint256 amountToShield = amount - (amount % rate);\n        if (amountToShield == 0) return;\n        if (amountToShield / rate > type(uint64).max) return;\n\n        shieldTo(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function unshield(euint64 amount) public returns (euint64 burned) {\n        burned = update(msg.sender, address(0), amount);\n        FHE.allowPublic(burned);\n        createClaim(msg.sender, burned);\n        emit TokensUnshielded(msg.sender, burned);\n    }\n\n    function unshieldChecked(sharedEuint64 sharedAmount) public returns (euint64) {\n        return unshield(FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount));\n    }\n\n    function claimUnshielded(bytes32 id, uint64 decryptedAmount, bytes calldata decryptionProof) public {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        Claim memory claim = handleClaim(id, decryptedAmount, decryptionProof);\n\n        uint256 amountPublic = uint256(claim.decryptedAmount) * $._conversionRate;\n        IConfidentialLedger(address(this)).__ledger(CONFIDENTIAL_POOL, claim.to, amountPublic);\n        syncConfidentialTotalSupply();\n\n        emit UnshieldedTokensClaimed(claim.to, id, FHE.wrapEuint64(claim.ctHash), claim.decryptedAmount);\n    }\n\n    function confidentialMint(address to, uint64 amount) public {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        IConfidentialLedger(address(this)).__ledger(address(0), CONFIDENTIAL_POOL, uint256(amount) * $._conversionRate);\n        update(address(0), to, FHE.asEuint64(amount));\n        syncConfidentialTotalSupply();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Materializes the confidential total supply (pool balance / conversion rate) as a\n    /// REGISTERED ciphertext handle. Runs inside every pool-balance-changing operation (shield /\n    /// claim / confidential mint \u2014 NOT unshield: the pool keeps custody until the claim settles,\n    /// so the supply still counts pending claims, same as the pool balance itself). The plaintext\n    /// is derived from public state, so a trivial encryption suffices \u2014 no FHE arithmetic.\n    /// `allowPublic` is deliberate: the value was never secret (anyone can read the pool's public\n    /// balance), and the global ACL grant covers EVERY account \u2014 decryption by any consumer, use\n    /// in other contracts' FHE ops, and the host's own future access (so no `allowThis` needed:\n    /// `isAllowed` = transient \u2228 persisted \u2228 global).\n    function syncConfidentialTotalSupply() public {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        euint64 supply = FHE.asEuint64(confidentialTotalSupplyPlaintext());\n        FHE.allowPublic(supply);\n        $._confidentialTotalSupply = supply;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The confidential total supply as a plaintext \u2014 pool balance scaled to confidential\n    /// decimals; the source of truth {syncConfidentialTotalSupply} encrypts. SATURATES at\n    /// `type(uint64).max` rather than reverting on overflow: the value feeds `FHE.asEuint64`, and\n    /// the stored supply is an informational `euint64` that cannot represent more than that anyway.\n    /// Clamping (not `SafeCast`) is deliberate \u2014 `syncConfidentialTotalSupply` runs inside\n    /// shield / claimUnshielded / confidentialMint, and `CONFIDENTIAL_POOL` is a plain address\n    /// whose public balance ANYONE can inflate with a direct token transfer (\"donation\"). A hard\n    /// downcast revert here would let such a donation brick those flows (and, since the claim leg\n    /// syncs after draining the pool, permanently deadlock claims). See audit run-3 Finding 9. The\n    /// host's `uint256` view twin stays exact/unclamped for consumers that need the true figure.\n    function confidentialTotalSupplyPlaintext() internal view returns (uint64) {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        uint256 supply = IConfidentialLedger(address(this)).balanceOf(CONFIDENTIAL_POOL) / $._conversionRate;\n        return supply > type(uint64).max ? type(uint64).max : uint64(supply);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Confidential transfer surface (full orchestration; host wrappers are 1-liners)\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    // Under delegatecall from the host, `address(this)` is the host token, so the share/receive\n    // pair below binds to the host \u2014 not to this library's own address.\n\n    function confTransfer(address to, sharedEuint64 sharedValue) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 value = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedValue);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(_move(msg.sender, to, value), msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferIn(\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 inValue,\n        bytes memory inputProof\n    ) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 transferred = _move(msg.sender, to, FHE.asEuint64(inValue, inputProof));\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferFrom(address from, address to, sharedEuint64 sharedValue) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 value = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedValue);\n        if (!_isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert ERC20ConfidentialUnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(_move(from, to, value), msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferFromIn(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 inValue,\n        bytes memory inputProof\n    ) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        if (!_isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert ERC20ConfidentialUnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        euint64 transferred = _move(from, to, FHE.asEuint64(inValue, inputProof));\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferAndCall(\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(_moveAndCall(msg.sender, to, amount, data), msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferAndCallIn(\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 inAmount,\n        bytes memory inputProof,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 transferred = _moveAndCall(msg.sender, to, FHE.asEuint64(inAmount, inputProof), data);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferFromAndCall(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        if (!_isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert ERC20ConfidentialUnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(_moveAndCall(from, to, amount, data), msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function confTransferFromAndCallIn(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 inAmount,\n        bytes memory inputProof,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        if (!_isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert ERC20ConfidentialUnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        euint64 transferred = _moveAndCall(from, to, FHE.asEuint64(inAmount, inputProof), data);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function isOperator(address holder, address spender) public view returns (bool) {\n        return _isOperator(holder, spender);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Internal helpers (inline within the library)\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    function _move(address from, address to, euint64 value) internal returns (euint64) {\n        if (from == address(0)) revert ConfidentialInvalidSender(address(0));\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ConfidentialInvalidReceiver(address(0));\n        return update(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Credits `to`, asks `to` whether it accepts, and refunds `from` if it does not.\n     *\n     * Checks the ctHash of the receiver before and after the call to ensure it did not move its own balance.\n     * This is a redundant safety check - reentrancy guards on token transfers will revert if the receiver attempts to move its own balance.\n     */\n    function _moveAndCall(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        euint64 amount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) internal returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        euint64 sent = _move(from, to, amount);\n\n        bytes32 balanceBefore = FHE.unwrap(_getERC20ConfidentialStorage()._confidentialBalances[to]);\n\n        ebool success = FHERC20Utils.checkOnTransferReceived(msg.sender, from, to, sent, data);\n\n        if (FHE.unwrap(_getERC20ConfidentialStorage()._confidentialBalances[to]) != balanceBefore) {\n            revert ConfidentialReceiverMovedBalance(to);\n        }\n\n        euint64 refund = update(to, from, FHE.select(success, FHE.asEuint64(0), sent));\n        transferred = FHE.sub(sent, refund);\n    }\n\n    function _isOperator(address holder, address spender) internal view returns (bool) {\n        ERC20ConfidentialStorage storage $ = _getERC20ConfidentialStorage();\n        return holder == spender || block.timestamp <= $._operators[holder][spender];\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Unshield-claim bookkeeping (relocated from FHERC20WrapperClaimHelper).\n    //  Uses its own ERC-7201 slot; the host delegates here so the (chunky)\n    //  EnumerableSet code lives in the library, not in the token.\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    using EnumerableSet for EnumerableSet.Bytes32Set;\n\n    struct Claim {\n        bytes32 id; // unique per-claimant key (NOT the ciphertext handle); how the claim is referenced\n        address to;\n        bytes32 ctHash; // the burned ciphertext handle; binds the decryption proof in handleClaim\n        uint64 decryptedAmount; // the PROVEN settle amount (set in handleClaim); the only trusted plaintext\n        bool claimed;\n    }\n\n    /// @custom:storage-location erc7201:fherc20.storage.FHERC20WrapperClaimHelper\n    struct ClaimStorage {\n        mapping(bytes32 id => Claim) _claims; // keyed by claim id, NOT by the ciphertext handle\n        mapping(address => EnumerableSet.Bytes32Set) _userClaims; // holds claim ids\n        mapping(address => uint256) _claimNonce; // per-claimant counter for unique id derivation\n    }\n\n    // keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256(\"fherc20.storage.FHERC20WrapperClaimHelper\")) - 1)) & ~bytes32(uint256(0xff))\n    bytes32 private constant CLAIM_SLOT = 0x90973842d0546f0dce9511f9a89cc80d5315812909eb805129843b5aeeaaae00;\n\n    error ClaimNotFound();\n    error AlreadyClaimed();\n    error InvalidDecryptionProof();\n\n    function _claimStore() private pure returns (ClaimStorage storage $) {\n        assembly {\n            $.slot := CLAIM_SLOT\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Records a pending unshield claim keyed by a UNIQUE per-claimant id, not by the\n    /// ciphertext handle. CoFHE handles are content-addressed (a pure function of the operation\n    /// lineage, with no per-caller or per-call salt), so two unshields of an identical\n    /// burned-amount lineage produce the SAME handle; keying claims by that handle would let a\n    /// second unshield overwrite the first claimant's record and redirect their payout. The\n    /// handle is retained as `ctHash` to bind the decryption proof in {handleClaim}.\n    function createClaim(address to, euint64 claimable) public returns (bytes32 id) {\n        ClaimStorage storage $ = _claimStore();\n        bytes32 h = FHE.unwrap(claimable);\n        id = keccak256(abi.encode(to, $._claimNonce[to]++, h));\n        $._claims[id] = Claim({ id: id, to: to, ctHash: h, decryptedAmount: 0, claimed: false });\n        $._userClaims[to].add(id);\n    }\n\n    function handleClaim(\n        bytes32 id,\n        uint64 decryptedAmount,\n        bytes memory decryptionProof\n    ) public returns (Claim memory claim) {\n        ClaimStorage storage $ = _claimStore();\n        claim = $._claims[id];\n        if (claim.to == address(0)) revert ClaimNotFound();\n        if (claim.claimed) revert AlreadyClaimed();\n\n        // The proof binds `decryptedAmount` to the burned handle (`ctHash`), which is fixed at\n        // createClaim time \u2014 never to the caller-supplied `id`.\n        if (!FHE.verifyDecryptResultSafe(FHE.wrapEuint64(claim.ctHash), decryptedAmount, decryptionProof)) {\n            revert InvalidDecryptionProof();\n        }\n\n        claim.decryptedAmount = decryptedAmount;\n        claim.claimed = true;\n        $._claims[id] = claim;\n        $._userClaims[claim.to].remove(id);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Re-points an UNSETTLED claim at `newTo`, keeping its id, and moves it between the\n    /// two `_userClaims` sets. Pure bookkeeping: authorization is the host's job (see\n    /// {FHERC20WrapperClaims-reassignClaim}), which is the only caller that knows the operator\n    /// rules.\n    function reassignClaim(bytes32 id, address newTo) public returns (Claim memory claim) {\n        ClaimStorage storage $ = _claimStore();\n        claim = $._claims[id];\n        if (claim.to == address(0)) revert ClaimNotFound();\n        if (claim.claimed) revert AlreadyClaimed();\n\n        $._userClaims[claim.to].remove(id);\n        claim.to = newTo;\n        $._claims[id] = claim;\n        $._userClaims[newTo].add(id);\n    }\n\n    function getClaim(bytes32 id) public view returns (Claim memory) {\n        return _claimStore()._claims[id];\n    }\n\n    function getUserClaims(address user) public view returns (Claim[] memory userClaims) {\n        ClaimStorage storage $ = _claimStore();\n        bytes32[] memory ids = $._userClaims[user].values();\n        userClaims = new Claim[](ids.length);\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {\n            userClaims[i] = $._claims[ids[i]];\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x3dd7735215c37405e9f48af4fd4b5b295c473ce67f54a1bd1687538b795410c1","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/FHERC20.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { Context } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Context.sol\";\nimport { IERC165 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC165.sol\";\nimport { ERC165 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/introspection/ERC165.sol\";\nimport { IFHERC20, IERC7984 } from \"../interfaces/IFHERC20.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20Core } from \"./FHERC20Core.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @dev Reference implementation for {IFHERC20} \u2014 constructor-based host over {FHERC20Core}.\n *\n * All FHERC20 logic (encrypted balances/transfers, operators, indicator view layer, disclosure)\n * lives in {FHERC20Core}, shared with {FHERC20Upgradeable}. This contract only guards one-time\n * setup with a constructor and supplies the ERC-165 answers.\n *\n * See {FHERC20Core} for the full behavioral documentation.\n */\nabstract contract FHERC20 is Context, ERC165, FHERC20Core {\n    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_, uint8 decimals_, string memory contractURI_) {\n        __FHERC20Core_init(name_, symbol_, decimals_, contractURI_);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  ERC-165\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /// @inheritdoc ERC165\n    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override(IERC165, ERC165) returns (bool) {\n        return\n            interfaceId == type(IFHERC20).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IERC7984).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IERC20).interfaceId ||\n            super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x597e563c8c3f45d4fc4e0bfbc972a9286c56f7c245c33e2432d53cdb802238d6","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/FHERC20Core.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { FHE, euint64, externalEuint64, sharedEuint64, ebool } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\nimport { ReentrancyGuardTransient } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuardTransient.sol\";\n\nimport { IFHERC20, IERC7984 } from \"../interfaces/IFHERC20.sol\";\nimport { FHESafeMath } from \"../utils/FHESafeMath.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20Utils } from \"./utils/FHERC20Utils.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20InvalidReceiver, FHERC20InvalidSender, FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender, FHERC20ZeroBalance, FHERC20UnauthorizedUseOfEncryptedAmount, FHERC20IncompatibleFunction, FHERC20ReceiverMovedBalance, InvalidDecryptionProof } from \"./utils/FHERC20Errors.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @dev Shared core of the {IFHERC20} reference implementation \u2014 the single home of all FHERC20\n * logic, hosted by both the constructor-based {FHERC20} and the proxy-friendly\n * {FHERC20Upgradeable} (which previously each carried a full copy of this code).\n *\n * This contract implements a fungible token where balances and transfers are encrypted using the\n * Fhenix CoFHE coprocessor, providing confidentiality to users. Token amounts are stored as\n * encrypted, unsigned integers (`euint64`) that can only be decrypted by authorized parties.\n *\n * Design notes:\n * - State lives in the SAME ERC-7201 namespaced struct ({FHERC20Storage}, slot\n *   `fherc20.storage.FHERC20`) that {FHERC20Upgradeable} always used, so existing upgradeable\n *   proxies keep their storage across an upgrade to a host built on this core.\n * - Setup is a plain `internal` {__FHERC20Core_init} \u2014 the HOST guards one-time initialization\n *   (a constructor for {FHERC20}, an OZ initializer for {FHERC20Upgradeable}).\n * - No OZ bases and no `supportsInterface` here: the hosts bring their own `Context`/`ERC165`\n *   flavor and ERC-165 answers.\n *\n * ERC-20 Compatibility: {balanceOf} and {totalSupply} return **indicator values** (not real\n * balances). The indicator starts at `7984.0000` on first interaction and shifts by `0.0001`\n * per transfer, signalling that this is a confidential token. ERC-20 mutative functions\n * (`transfer`, `transferFrom`, `approve`) revert unconditionally.\n */\nabstract contract FHERC20Core is IFHERC20, ReentrancyGuardTransient {\n    /// @custom:storage-location erc7201:fherc20.storage.FHERC20\n    struct FHERC20Storage {\n        mapping(address account => euint64) _balances;\n        mapping(address account => mapping(address spender => uint48)) _operators;\n        euint64 _totalSupply;\n        string _name;\n        string _symbol;\n        uint8 _decimals;\n        string _contractURI;\n        mapping(address account => uint32) _indicatedBalances;\n        uint32 _indicatedTotalSupply;\n        uint256 _indicatorTick;\n    }\n\n    // keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256(\"fherc20.storage.FHERC20\")) - 1)) & ~bytes32(uint256(0xff))\n    bytes32 private constant FHERC20StorageLocation =\n        0x174ed16d97a61a153aad3a46b164784ea06dfc9084805e63b17bf268e438df00;\n\n    function _getFHERC20Storage() private pure returns (FHERC20Storage storage $) {\n        assembly {\n            $.slot := FHERC20StorageLocation\n        }\n    }\n\n    uint32 private constant _INDICATOR_BASE = 79_840_000;\n    uint32 private constant _INDICATOR_TRANSFER = 79_840_001;\n\n    /// @dev Emitted when an encrypted amount `encryptedAmount` is requested for disclosure by `requester`.\n    event AmountDiscloseRequested(euint64 indexed encryptedAmount, address indexed requester);\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Sets the values for {name}, {symbol}, {decimals}, and {contractURI}.\n     *\n     * Plain `internal` \u2014 no `Initializable` here. The host guards one-time setup: {FHERC20}\n     * calls this from its constructor, {FHERC20Upgradeable} from its `onlyInitializing` init.\n     */\n    function __FHERC20Core_init(\n        string memory name_,\n        string memory symbol_,\n        uint8 decimals_,\n        string memory contractURI_\n    ) internal {\n        FHERC20Storage storage $ = _getFHERC20Storage();\n        $._name = name_;\n        $._symbol = symbol_;\n        $._decimals = decimals_;\n        $._contractURI = contractURI_;\n        $._indicatorTick = decimals_ <= 4 ? 1 : 10 ** (decimals_ - 4);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  ERC-20 indicator (backwards-compatible view layer)\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns an indicator of the underlying encrypted total supply. The value is **not** the\n     * real total supply \u2014 it is a counter that starts at `7984.0000` on first mint and shifts by\n     * `0.0001` per mint/burn.\n     */\n    function totalSupply() public view virtual returns (uint256) {\n        FHERC20Storage storage $ = _getFHERC20Storage();\n        return uint256($._indicatedTotalSupply) * $._indicatorTick;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns an indicator of the underlying encrypted balance. The value is **not** the real\n     * balance \u2014 it is a counter that starts at `7984.0001` on first interaction and shifts by\n     * `0.0001` per send/receive. A return value of `0` means the account has never interacted.\n     */\n    function balanceOf(address account) public view virtual returns (uint256) {\n        FHERC20Storage storage $ = _getFHERC20Storage();\n        return uint256($._indicatedBalances[account]) * $._indicatorTick;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Always reverts. Use {confidentialTransfer} instead.\n    function transfer(address, uint256) public pure returns (bool) {\n        revert FHERC20IncompatibleFunction();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Always reverts. Use {confidentialTransferFrom} instead.\n    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) public pure returns (bool) {\n        revert FHERC20IncompatibleFunction();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Always reverts. Use {setOperator} instead.\n    function approve(address, uint256) public pure returns (bool) {\n        revert FHERC20IncompatibleFunction();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Always reverts. Allowances are replaced by time-bound operators.\n    function allowance(address, address) public pure returns (uint256) {\n        revert FHERC20IncompatibleFunction();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Returns `true`, signalling that {balanceOf} returns an indicator, not a real balance.\n    function balanceOfIsIndicator() public pure virtual returns (bool) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Returns the raw unit size of a single indicator tick (scales with {decimals}).\n    function indicatorTick() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._indicatorTick;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Resets the caller's indicated balance to `0` (no interaction).\n    function resetIndicatedBalance() external {\n        _getFHERC20Storage()._indicatedBalances[msg.sender] = 0;\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  IERC7984 view functions\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function name() public view virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._name;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function symbol() public view virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._symbol;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function decimals() public view virtual returns (uint8) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._decimals;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function contractURI() public view virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._contractURI;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTotalSupply() public view virtual returns (euint64) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._totalSupply;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialBalanceOf(address account) public view virtual returns (euint64) {\n        return _getFHERC20Storage()._balances[account];\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function isOperator(address holder, address spender) public view virtual returns (bool) {\n        return holder == spender || block.timestamp <= _getFHERC20Storage()._operators[holder][spender];\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  IERC7984 mutative functions\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function setOperator(address operator, uint48 until) public virtual {\n        _setOperator(msg.sender, operator, until);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransfer(\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 encryptedAmount,\n        bytes calldata inputProof\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 transferred = _transfer(msg.sender, to, FHE.asEuint64(encryptedAmount, inputProof));\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransfer(\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        euint64 transferred = _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransferFrom(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 encryptedAmount,\n        bytes calldata inputProof\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        if (!isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        euint64 transferred = _transfer(from, to, FHE.asEuint64(encryptedAmount, inputProof));\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransferFrom(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        if (!isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        euint64 transferred = _transfer(from, to, amount);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransferAndCall(\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 encryptedAmount,\n        bytes calldata inputProof,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 transferred = _transferAndCall(msg.sender, to, FHE.asEuint64(encryptedAmount, inputProof), data);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransferAndCall(\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        euint64 transferred = _transferAndCall(msg.sender, to, amount, data);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransferFromAndCall(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        externalEuint64 encryptedAmount,\n        bytes calldata inputProof,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        if (!isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        euint64 transferred = _transferAndCall(from, to, FHE.asEuint64(encryptedAmount, inputProof), data);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7984\n    function confidentialTransferFromAndCall(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        if (!isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n        euint64 transferred = _transferAndCall(from, to, amount, data);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(transferred, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Disclosure\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Starts the process to disclose an encrypted amount `encryptedAmount` publicly by making it\n     * publicly decryptable. Emits the {AmountDiscloseRequested} event.\n     *\n     * NOTE: Both `msg.sender` and `address(this)` must have permission to access the encrypted amount\n     * `encryptedAmount` to request disclosure of the encrypted amount `encryptedAmount`.\n     */\n    function requestDiscloseEncryptedAmount(euint64 encryptedAmount) public virtual {\n        if (!FHE.isAllowed(encryptedAmount, msg.sender))\n            revert FHERC20UnauthorizedUseOfEncryptedAmount(encryptedAmount, msg.sender);\n\n        FHE.allowPublic(encryptedAmount);\n        emit AmountDiscloseRequested(encryptedAmount, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Publicly discloses an encrypted value with a given decryption proof. Emits the {AmountDisclosed} event.\n     *\n     * NOTE: May not be tied to a prior request via {requestDiscloseEncryptedAmount}.\n     */\n    function discloseEncryptedAmount(\n        euint64 encryptedAmount,\n        uint64 cleartextAmount,\n        bytes calldata decryptionProof\n    ) public virtual {\n        if (!FHE.verifyDecryptResultSafe(encryptedAmount, cleartextAmount, decryptionProof)) {\n            revert InvalidDecryptionProof();\n        }\n        emit AmountDisclosed(encryptedAmount, cleartextAmount);\n    }\n\n    // =========================================================================\n    //  Internal helpers\n    // =========================================================================\n\n    function _setOperator(address holder, address operator, uint48 until) internal virtual {\n        _getFHERC20Storage()._operators[holder][operator] = until;\n        emit OperatorSet(holder, operator, until);\n    }\n\n    function _mint(address to, euint64 amount) internal returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert FHERC20InvalidReceiver(address(0));\n        return _update(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function _burn(address from, euint64 amount) internal returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        if (from == address(0)) revert FHERC20InvalidSender(address(0));\n        return _update(from, address(0), amount);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, euint64 amount) internal returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        if (from == address(0)) revert FHERC20InvalidSender(address(0));\n        if (to == address(0)) revert FHERC20InvalidReceiver(address(0));\n        return _update(from, to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Credits `to`, asks `to` whether it accepts, and refunds `from` if it does not.\n     *\n     * Checks the ctHash of the receiver before and after the call to ensure it did not move its own balance.\n     * This is a redundant safety check - reentrancy guards on token transfers will revert if the receiver attempts to move its own balance.\n     */\n    function _transferAndCall(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        euint64 amount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) internal returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        euint64 sent = _transfer(from, to, amount);\n\n        bytes32 balanceBefore = FHE.unwrap(_getFHERC20Storage()._balances[to]);\n\n        ebool success = FHERC20Utils.checkOnTransferReceived(msg.sender, from, to, sent, data);\n\n        if (FHE.unwrap(_getFHERC20Storage()._balances[to]) != balanceBefore) {\n            revert FHERC20ReceiverMovedBalance(to);\n        }\n\n        euint64 refund = _update(to, from, FHE.select(success, FHE.asEuint64(0), sent));\n        transferred = FHE.sub(sent, refund);\n    }\n\n    function _incrementIndicator(uint32 current) internal pure returns (uint32) {\n        if (current == 0) return _INDICATOR_BASE + 1;\n        return current + 1;\n    }\n\n    function _decrementIndicator(uint32 current) internal pure returns (uint32) {\n        if (current == 0) return _INDICATOR_BASE;\n        return current - 1;\n    }\n\n    function _update(address from, address to, euint64 amount) internal virtual returns (euint64 transferred) {\n        FHERC20Storage storage $ = _getFHERC20Storage();\n        ebool success;\n        euint64 ptr;\n\n        if (from == address(0)) {\n            (success, ptr) = FHESafeMath.tryIncrease($._totalSupply, amount);\n            FHE.allowThis(ptr);\n            $._totalSupply = ptr;\n            $._indicatedTotalSupply = _incrementIndicator($._indicatedTotalSupply);\n        } else {\n            euint64 fromBalance = $._balances[from];\n            if (!FHE.isInitialized(fromBalance)) revert FHERC20ZeroBalance(from);\n            (success, ptr) = FHESafeMath.tryDecrease(fromBalance, amount);\n            FHE.allowThis(ptr);\n            FHE.allow(ptr, from);\n            $._balances[from] = ptr;\n            $._indicatedBalances[from] = _decrementIndicator($._indicatedBalances[from]);\n        }\n\n        transferred = FHE.select(success, amount, FHE.asEuint64(0));\n\n        if (to == address(0)) {\n            ptr = FHE.sub($._totalSupply, transferred);\n            FHE.allowThis(ptr);\n            $._totalSupply = ptr;\n            $._indicatedTotalSupply = _decrementIndicator($._indicatedTotalSupply);\n        } else {\n            ptr = FHE.add($._balances[to], transferred);\n            FHE.allowThis(ptr);\n            FHE.allow(ptr, to);\n            $._balances[to] = ptr;\n            $._indicatedBalances[to] = _incrementIndicator($._indicatedBalances[to]);\n        }\n\n        if (from != address(0)) FHE.allow(transferred, from);\n        if (to != address(0)) FHE.allow(transferred, to);\n        FHE.allowThis(transferred);\n\n        emit Transfer(from, to, uint256(_INDICATOR_TRANSFER) * $._indicatorTick);\n        emit ConfidentialTransfer(from, to, transferred);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x154939ece04dce95a18d85417cd672385c4afdefe0ddef339395cc0cf99ec871","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/extensions/FHERC20ERC20Wrapper.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { euint64 } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\nimport { IERC1363Receiver } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC1363Receiver.sol\";\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { IERC165 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC165.sol\";\nimport { IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper } from \"../../interfaces/IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20 } from \"../FHERC20.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20Core } from \"../FHERC20Core.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore } from \"./FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @dev Constructor-based host of {FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore}: shields an `ERC20` token into a\n * confidential {FHERC20} token. All wrapper logic lives in the shared core (see its docs for\n * behavior, claim keying, and the library-linking requirement).\n */\nabstract contract FHERC20ERC20Wrapper is FHERC20, FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore {\n    constructor(IERC20 underlying_) {\n        __FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore_init(underlying_);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc FHERC20\n    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override(FHERC20, IERC165) returns (bool) {\n        return\n            interfaceId == type(IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IERC1363Receiver).interfaceId ||\n            super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);\n    }\n\n    // \u2500\u2500 diamond disambiguation \u2014 the wrapper core's overrides win \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n    function decimals() public view virtual override(FHERC20Core, FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore) returns (uint8) {\n        return super.decimals();\n    }\n\n    function _update(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        euint64 amount\n    ) internal virtual override(FHERC20Core, FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore) returns (euint64) {\n        return super._update(from, to, amount);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x99261ebc9ee5bbbe5e558b79e0705dd3f1a3688a5d631c8e3b78617a400b00c4","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/extensions/FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { FHE, euint64, sharedEuint64 } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\n\nimport { IERC1363Receiver } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC1363Receiver.sol\";\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { IERC20Metadata } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC20Metadata.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeCast } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeCast.sol\";\nimport { IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper } from \"../../interfaces/IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper.sol\";\nimport { ERC20ConfidentialLib } from \"../../ERC20Confidential/ERC20ConfidentialLib.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20Core } from \"../FHERC20Core.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20WrapperClaims } from \"../utils/FHERC20WrapperClaims.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20InvalidReceiver, FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender, FHERC20UnauthorizedCaller, FHERC20UnauthorizedUseOfEncryptedAmount } from \"../utils/FHERC20Errors.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @dev Shared core of the ERC-20 wrapper \u2014 the single home of the wrap/shield/unshield/claim\n * logic, hosted by both the constructor-based {FHERC20ERC20Wrapper} and the proxy-friendly\n * {FHERC20ERC20WrapperUpgradeable} (which previously each carried a full copy of this code).\n *\n * Shields an `ERC20` token into an `FHERC20` token. Implements `IERC1363Receiver`, which allows\n * users to transfer `ERC1363` tokens directly to the wrapper with a callback to shield the tokens.\n *\n * Unshield claims are keyed by a unique per-claimant id (see {FHERC20WrapperClaims}) and their\n * bookkeeping lives in the linked {ERC20ConfidentialLib} \u2014 hosts must link the library.\n *\n * Wrapper config lives in the SAME ERC-7201 slot (`fherc20.storage.FHERC20ERC20Wrapper`) the\n * upgradeable variant always used, so existing proxies keep it across an upgrade.\n *\n * WARNING: Minting assumes the full amount of the underlying token transfer has been received, hence some non-standard\n * tokens such as fee-on-transfer or other deflationary-type tokens are not supported by this wrapper.\n */\nabstract contract FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore is FHERC20Core, IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper, IERC1363Receiver, FHERC20WrapperClaims {\n    /// @custom:storage-location erc7201:fherc20.storage.FHERC20ERC20Wrapper\n    struct FHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage {\n        IERC20 _underlying;\n        uint8 _wrappedDecimals;\n        uint256 _rate;\n    }\n\n    // keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256(\"fherc20.storage.FHERC20ERC20Wrapper\")) - 1)) & ~bytes32(uint256(0xff))\n    bytes32 private constant FHERC20ERC20WrapperStorageLocation =\n        0x4e88f5b0860d1f98706c128e62bcc7e5dbeb109d021b0117348148502362e000;\n\n    function _getFHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage() private pure returns (FHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage storage $) {\n        assembly {\n            $.slot := FHERC20ERC20WrapperStorageLocation\n        }\n    }\n\n    error FHERC20TotalSupplyOverflow();\n\n    /// @dev Plain `internal` \u2014 the host guards one-time setup (constructor or OZ initializer).\n    function __FHERC20ERC20WrapperCore_init(IERC20 underlying_) internal {\n        FHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage storage $ = _getFHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage();\n        $._underlying = underlying_;\n\n        uint8 tokenDecimals = _tryGetAssetDecimals(underlying_);\n        uint8 maxDecimals = _maxDecimals();\n        if (tokenDecimals > maxDecimals) {\n            $._wrappedDecimals = maxDecimals;\n            $._rate = 10 ** (tokenDecimals - maxDecimals);\n        } else {\n            $._wrappedDecimals = tokenDecimals;\n            $._rate = 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev `ERC1363` callback function which shields tokens to the address specified in `data` or\n     * the address `from` (if no address is specified in `data`). This function refunds any excess tokens\n     * sent beyond the nearest multiple of {rate} to `from`. See {shield} for more details on shielding tokens.\n     */\n    function onTransferReceived(\n        address,\n        address from,\n        uint256 amount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (bytes4) {\n        if (underlying() != msg.sender) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedCaller(msg.sender);\n\n        address to = data.length < 20 ? from : address(bytes20(data));\n        _mint(to, FHE.asEuint64(SafeCast.toUint64(amount / rate())));\n\n        uint256 excess = amount % rate();\n        if (excess > 0) SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(underlying()), from, excess);\n\n        return IERC1363Receiver.onTransferReceived.selector;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev See {IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper-shield}. Tokens are exchanged at a fixed rate specified by {rate} such that\n     * `amount / rate()` confidential tokens are sent. The amount transferred in is rounded down to the nearest\n     * multiple of {rate}.\n     *\n     * Returns the amount of shielded token sent.\n     */\n    function shield(address to, uint256 amount) public virtual override nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(IERC20(underlying()), msg.sender, address(this), amount - (amount % rate()));\n\n        euint64 shieldedAmountSent = _mint(to, FHE.asEuint64(SafeCast.toUint64(amount / rate())));\n\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(shieldedAmountSent, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Initiates an unshield of `amount` confidential tokens from `from`, creating a pending\n     * claim for `to`. The caller must be `from` or an operator for `from`.\n     *\n     * Returns the encrypted amount that was burned. The claim is keyed by a unique id \u2014 read it\n     * from {getClaim}/{getUserClaims}, NOT from the burned handle.\n     */\n    function unshield(address from, address to, uint64 amount) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(_unshield(from, to, FHE.asEuint64(amount)), msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Initiates an unshield of an encrypted `amount` from `from`, creating a pending\n     * unshield request for `to`. The caller must have ACL access to `amount` and must be\n     * `from` or an operator for `from`.\n     *\n     * Returns the encrypted amount that was burned.\n     */\n    function unshield(\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        sharedEuint64 sharedAmount\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        euint64 amount = FHE.receiveEuint64Param(sharedAmount);\n        return FHE.shareEuint64(_unshield(from, to, amount), msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Claims a pending unshield request by its unique claim id. Verifies the decryption\n     * proof and transfers `decryptedAmount * rate()` underlying tokens to the requester.\n     */\n    function claimUnshielded(\n        bytes32 id,\n        uint64 decryptedAmount,\n        bytes memory decryptionProof\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant {\n        ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim memory claim = _handleClaim(id, decryptedAmount, decryptionProof);\n        SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(underlying()), claim.to, uint256(claim.decryptedAmount) * rate());\n        emit ClaimedUnshielded(claim.to, id, FHE.wrapEuint64(claim.ctHash), claim.decryptedAmount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Claims multiple pending unshield requests (by unique claim ids) in a single transaction.\n     */\n    function claimUnshieldedBatch(\n        bytes32[] memory ids,\n        uint64[] memory decryptedAmounts,\n        bytes[] memory decryptionProofs\n    ) public virtual nonReentrant {\n        ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim[] memory claims = _handleClaimBatch(ids, decryptedAmounts, decryptionProofs);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < claims.length; i++) {\n            SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(underlying()), claims[i].to, uint256(claims[i].decryptedAmount) * rate());\n            emit ClaimedUnshielded(claims[i].to, ids[i], FHE.wrapEuint64(claims[i].ctHash), claims[i].decryptedAmount);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc FHERC20Core\n    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {\n        return _getFHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage()._wrappedDecimals;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper\n    function rate() public view virtual returns (uint256) {\n        return _getFHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage()._rate;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IFHERC20ERC20Wrapper\n    function underlying() public view virtual override returns (address) {\n        return address(_getFHERC20ERC20WrapperStorage()._underlying);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the underlying balance divided by the {rate}, a value greater or equal to the actual\n     * {confidentialTotalSupply}.\n     *\n     * NOTE: The return value of this function can be inflated by directly sending underlying tokens to the wrapper contract.\n     * Reductions will lag compared to {confidentialTotalSupply} since it is updated on {unshield} while this function updates\n     * on {claimUnshielded}.\n     */\n    function inferredTotalSupply() public view virtual returns (uint256) {\n        return IERC20(underlying()).balanceOf(address(this)) / rate();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Returns the maximum total supply of shielded tokens supported by the encrypted datatype.\n    function maxTotalSupply() public view virtual returns (uint256) {\n        return type(uint64).max;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev This function must revert if the new {confidentialTotalSupply} is invalid (overflow occurred).\n     *\n     * NOTE: Overflow can be detected here since the wrapper holdings are non-confidential. In other cases, it may be impossible\n     * to infer total supply overflow synchronously. This function may revert even if the {confidentialTotalSupply} did\n     * not overflow.\n     */\n    function _checkConfidentialTotalSupply() internal virtual {\n        if (inferredTotalSupply() > maxTotalSupply()) {\n            revert FHERC20TotalSupplyOverflow();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc FHERC20Core\n    function _update(address from, address to, euint64 amount) internal virtual override returns (euint64) {\n        if (from == address(0)) {\n            _checkConfidentialTotalSupply();\n        }\n        return super._update(from, to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc FHERC20WrapperClaims\n    function _isClaimOperator(address holder, address spender) internal view virtual override returns (bool) {\n        return isOperator(holder, spender);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Shared internal logic for both unshield overloads.\n    function _unshield(address from, address to, euint64 amount) internal virtual returns (euint64) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert FHERC20InvalidReceiver(to);\n        if (from != msg.sender && !isOperator(from, msg.sender)) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(from, msg.sender);\n\n        euint64 unshieldAmount_ = _burn(from, amount);\n        FHE.allowPublic(unshieldAmount_);\n\n        _createClaim(to, unshieldAmount_);\n\n        emit Unshielded(to, unshieldAmount_);\n        return unshieldAmount_;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the default number of decimals of the underlying ERC-20 token.\n     * Used as a fallback when {_tryGetAssetDecimals} fails.\n     */\n    function _fallbackUnderlyingDecimals() internal pure virtual returns (uint8) {\n        return 18;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Returns the maximum number that will be used for {decimals} by the wrapper.\n    function _maxDecimals() internal pure virtual returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function _tryGetAssetDecimals(IERC20 asset_) private view returns (uint8 assetDecimals) {\n        (bool success, bytes memory encodedDecimals) = address(asset_).staticcall(\n            abi.encodeCall(IERC20Metadata.decimals, ())\n        );\n        if (success && encodedDecimals.length == 32) {\n            return abi.decode(encodedDecimals, (uint8));\n        }\n        return _fallbackUnderlyingDecimals();\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x03ab9122c2b3ab5d22d417410d178bf60fc591fc6704478870a49301621313b3","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/utils/FHERC20Errors.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { euint64 } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\n\n/// @dev The given receiver `receiver` is invalid for transfers.\nerror FHERC20InvalidReceiver(address receiver);\n\n/// @dev The given sender `sender` is invalid for transfers.\nerror FHERC20InvalidSender(address sender);\n\n/// @dev The given holder `holder` is not authorized to spend on behalf of `spender`.\nerror FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(address holder, address spender);\n\n/// @dev The holder `holder` is trying to send tokens but has a balance of 0.\nerror FHERC20ZeroBalance(address holder);\n\n/**\n * @dev The caller `user` does not have access to the encrypted amount `amount`.\n *\n * NOTE: Try using the equivalent transfer function with an input proof.\n */\nerror FHERC20UnauthorizedUseOfEncryptedAmount(euint64 amount, address user);\n\n/// @dev The given caller `caller` is not authorized for the current operation.\nerror FHERC20UnauthorizedCaller(address caller);\n\n/// @dev The receiver `receiver` moved its own balance during its transfer callback.\nerror FHERC20ReceiverMovedBalance(address receiver);\n\n/// @dev The supplied threshold-decryption proof does not bind the cleartext to the ciphertext.\nerror InvalidDecryptionProof();\n\n/// @dev Reverts when a cleartext ERC-20 function is called on a confidential token.\nerror FHERC20IncompatibleFunction();\n","keccak256":"0x69054431f28bea147f81031ce38cbd687ae4ab237ac859cc8e9e3e18c8fbe9f1","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/utils/FHERC20Utils.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { FHE, ebool, euint64, sharedEbool } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\n\nimport { IERC7984Receiver } from \"../../interfaces/IERC7984Receiver.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20InvalidReceiver } from \"./FHERC20Errors.sol\";\n\n/// @dev Library that provides common {FHERC20} utility functions.\nlibrary FHERC20Utils {\n    /**\n     * @dev Performs a transfer callback to the recipient of the transfer `to`. Should be invoked\n     * after all transfers \"withCallback\" on a {FHERC20}.\n     *\n     * The transfer callback is not invoked on the recipient if the recipient has no code (i.e. is an EOA). If the\n     * recipient has non-zero code, it must implement\n     * {IERC7984Receiver-onConfidentialTransferReceived} and return a `sharedEbool` indicating\n     * whether the transfer was accepted or not. If it decodes to `false`, the transfer function\n     * should try to refund the `from` address.\n     */\n    function checkOnTransferReceived(\n        address operator,\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        euint64 amount,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) internal returns (ebool) {\n        if (to.code.length > 0) {\n            try\n                IERC7984Receiver(to).onConfidentialTransferReceived(operator, from, FHE.shareEuint64(amount, to), data)\n            returns (sharedEbool retval) {\n                return FHE.receiveEboolFromCall(retval, to);\n            } catch (bytes memory reason) {\n                if (reason.length == 0) {\n                    revert FHERC20InvalidReceiver(to);\n                } else {\n                    assembly (\"memory-safe\") {\n                        revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            return FHE.asEbool(true);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xa5d29ece530504baed1e1c04a2c7d0799950f29f6b6ea688f3f482c7c5d74d08","license":"MIT"},"contracts/FHERC20/utils/FHERC20WrapperClaims.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { euint64 } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\nimport { ERC20ConfidentialLib } from \"../../ERC20Confidential/ERC20ConfidentialLib.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20InvalidReceiver, FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender } from \"./FHERC20Errors.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @dev Thin shared claim bookkeeping for {FHERC20} wrapper contracts, over the linked\n * {ERC20ConfidentialLib} claim store (delegatecall'd; hosts must link the library).\n *\n * Replaces the ctHash-keyed `FHERC20WrapperClaimHelper(Upgradeable)` pair: claims are keyed by a\n * UNIQUE per-claimant id \u2014 `keccak256(to, nonce++, handle)` \u2014 instead of the ciphertext handle.\n * CoFHE handles are content-addressed (no per-caller/per-call salt), so identical burned-amount\n * lineages yield identical handles; handle-keyed claims could therefore overwrite each other and\n * redirect payouts. The handle is retained as `Claim.ctHash` to bind the decryption proof.\n *\n * Storage lives in the SAME ERC-7201 slot the old helpers used\n * (`fherc20.storage.FHERC20WrapperClaimHelper`) but records are NOT layout-compatible (new key\n * derivation, leading `id` field) \u2014 pending claims do not survive an upgrade from the old helpers.\n */\nabstract contract FHERC20WrapperClaims {\n    // Mirrors of the library's errors so they appear in the host ABI (the library reverts them\n    // under delegatecall; same names \u2192 same selectors).\n    error ClaimNotFound();\n    error AlreadyClaimed();\n    error ClaimBatchLengthMismatch();\n    error InvalidDecryptionProof();\n\n    /// @notice Emitted when a pending claim is re-pointed at a new recipient.\n    event ClaimReassigned(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed previousTo, address indexed newTo);\n\n    /// @dev Host-supplied operator check, so the claim-owner gate below honours the same operator\n    /// rules the rest of the token uses. An internal hook rather than a re-declaration of the\n    /// host's public `isOperator`, which would force every wrapper core inheriting both this and\n    /// {FHERC20Core} to write an explicit `override(...)` disambiguation.\n    function _isClaimOperator(address holder, address spender) internal view virtual returns (bool);\n\n    /// @notice Pending-claim views, keyed by the unique claim id (NOT the ciphertext handle).\n    function getClaim(bytes32 id) public view returns (ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim memory) {\n        return ERC20ConfidentialLib.getClaim(id);\n    }\n\n    function getUserClaims(address user) public view returns (ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim[] memory) {\n        return ERC20ConfidentialLib.getUserClaims(user);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Re-points an unsettled claim at `newTo`. Callable by the claim's current recipient\n     * or an operator acting for them.\n     *\n     * A claim's recipient is fixed at burn time and settlement pays that address unconditionally,\n     * so a recipient that cannot accept the payout \u2014 a contract with no payable fallback on a\n     * native wrapper, a blocklisted address on an ERC-20 wrapper \u2014 would otherwise strand the\n     * burned value in the wrapper forever (Consensys Diligence 5.13). Reassignment is the escape\n     * hatch: the value is already the recipient's, so only the recipient may redirect it.\n     *\n     * The claim keeps its id, so a decryption proof obtained before the reassignment stays valid.\n     */\n    function reassignClaim(bytes32 id, address newTo) public virtual {\n        if (newTo == address(0)) revert FHERC20InvalidReceiver(newTo);\n\n        address previousTo = ERC20ConfidentialLib.getClaim(id).to;\n        if (previousTo == address(0)) revert ClaimNotFound();\n        _checkClaimRecipient(previousTo);\n\n        ERC20ConfidentialLib.reassignClaim(id, newTo);\n        emit ClaimReassigned(id, previousTo, newTo);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Reverts unless the caller is `to` or an operator acting for `to`.\n    function _checkClaimRecipient(address to) internal view {\n        if (!_isClaimOperator(to, msg.sender)) revert FHERC20UnauthorizedSpender(to, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Records a pending claim; returns its unique id.\n    function _createClaim(address to, euint64 claimable) internal returns (bytes32 id) {\n        return ERC20ConfidentialLib.createClaim(to, claimable);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Verifies the decryption proof for claim `id` and marks it claimed.\n    function _handleClaim(\n        bytes32 id,\n        uint64 decryptedAmount,\n        bytes memory decryptionProof\n    ) internal returns (ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim memory) {\n        return ERC20ConfidentialLib.handleClaim(id, decryptedAmount, decryptionProof);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Batch variant of {_handleClaim}; any invalid element reverts the whole batch.\n    function _handleClaimBatch(\n        bytes32[] memory ids,\n        uint64[] memory decryptedAmounts,\n        bytes[] memory decryptionProofs\n    ) internal returns (ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim[] memory claims) {\n        if (ids.length != decryptedAmounts.length || ids.length != decryptionProofs.length) {\n            revert ClaimBatchLengthMismatch();\n        }\n\n        claims = new ERC20ConfidentialLib.Claim[](ids.length);\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {\n            claims[i] = ERC20ConfidentialLib.handleClaim(ids[i], decryptedAmounts[i], decryptionProofs[i]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xb4621e5d4c41dc5e9b00322bb7828242214a95842c536208147c0f4aa5848a8e","license":"MIT"},"contracts/PrivateSend/PrivateSendUSDC.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.25;\n\nimport { FHE, euint64, sharedEuint64 } from \"@fhenixprotocol/cofhe-contracts/FHE.sol\";\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { Ownable, Ownable2Step } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\nimport { Pausable } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport { FHERC20 } from \"../FHERC20/FHERC20.sol\";\nimport { FHERC20ERC20Wrapper } from \"../FHERC20/extensions/FHERC20ERC20Wrapper.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title PrivateSendUSDC\n * @notice Confidential USDC for the Zon PayBox plugin.\n *\n * All money logic (shield, encrypted transfers, unshield, claim) is Fhenix's audited\n * FHERC20ERC20Wrapper, used unchanged. This contract only adds launch guard rails:\n *\n *  - Deposit caps: a lifetime cap per depositor AND per recipient, and a cap on total USDC held.\n *    The total is tracked internally, so USDC sent straight to the contract cannot fill the cap.\n *  - Pause switch: stops NEW deposits only. Private sends, unshield and claim always work,\n *    so a pause can never trap anyone's money.\n *  - No admin withdraw: the owner can change caps and pause deposits. Nothing else.\n *    There is no function that lets the owner, or anyone, move another person's funds.\n *    Ownership cannot be renounced, so caps and pause can never be frozen without an owner.\n *  - unshieldAll: lets a holder withdraw their whole confidential balance without first\n *    having to decrypt it (recipients often don't know their exact balance).\n */\ncontract PrivateSendUSDC is FHERC20ERC20Wrapper, Ownable2Step, Pausable {\n    /// @notice Max total USDC (underlying units) one address may ever shield, counted both for the\n    /// address that pays and for the address credited. 0 = no deposits.\n    uint256 public perUserShieldCap;\n    /// @notice Max USDC (underlying units) held for holders at once (deposits minus paid-out claims).\n    uint256 public totalShieldCap;\n    /// @notice Lifetime USDC shielded by each depositor (public anyway: deposits are on-chain).\n    mapping(address => uint256) public shieldedBy;\n    /// @notice Lifetime USDC shielded to each recipient.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public shieldedTo;\n    /// @notice USDC held for holders: counted deposits minus claimed payouts. Direct transfers to\n    /// the contract are not counted, so they cannot be used to block deposits.\n    uint256 public totalShielded;\n\n    event CapsUpdated(uint256 perUserShieldCap, uint256 totalShieldCap);\n\n    error PerUserCapExceeded(address account, uint256 attempted, uint256 cap);\n    error TotalCapExceeded(uint256 attemptedTotal, uint256 cap);\n    error DirectTokenCallbackDisabled();\n    error OwnershipCannotBeRenounced();\n\n    constructor(\n        IERC20 usdc,\n        address owner_,\n        uint256 perUserShieldCap_,\n        uint256 totalShieldCap_\n    ) FHERC20(\"Private USDC\", \"pUSDC\", 6, \"\") FHERC20ERC20Wrapper(usdc) Ownable(owner_) {\n        perUserShieldCap = perUserShieldCap_;\n        totalShieldCap = totalShieldCap_;\n        emit CapsUpdated(perUserShieldCap_, totalShieldCap_);\n    }\n\n    // \u2500\u2500 deposits (capped, pausable) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n    /// @notice Shield `amount` USDC into Private USDC for `to`, subject to the caps and the pause.\n    /// @dev Caps count only the part actually pulled in (rounded down to a multiple of {rate}).\n    function shield(address to, uint256 amount) public virtual override whenNotPaused returns (sharedEuint64) {\n        uint256 counted = amount - (amount % rate());\n\n        uint256 byTotal = shieldedBy[msg.sender] + counted;\n        if (byTotal > perUserShieldCap) revert PerUserCapExceeded(msg.sender, byTotal, perUserShieldCap);\n        shieldedBy[msg.sender] = byTotal;\n\n        uint256 toTotal = shieldedTo[to] + counted;\n        if (toTotal > perUserShieldCap) revert PerUserCapExceeded(to, toTotal, perUserShieldCap);\n        shieldedTo[to] = toTotal;\n\n        uint256 newHeld = totalShielded + counted;\n        if (newHeld > totalShieldCap) revert TotalCapExceeded(newHeld, totalShieldCap);\n        totalShielded = newHeld;\n\n        return super.shield(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The ERC-1363 deposit path would skip the caps and the pause.
